falsifier: every archived duplicate rejection names a kept partner that one countermeasure closes together with it
hypothesis: a duplicate rejection inside a group the service marks (one lane, one verb, one set of endpoint-resolved targets) drops a draft whose remedy differs from its kept partner's, as #1295 finding 3 claims
intervention: offline read of every STRIDE rejection with rejected_because duplicate in the four Baselines under evals/baselines/, beside the kept draft its reason names. Three rejections against 867 kept claims. 08 E-02 (a token that stays valid after the colleague leaves) against E-01 (no store-affiliation check): different remedies. 13 S-03 (an unverified WebSocket handshake on the live-job-status flow) against S-02 (cross-origin dispatch requests on another flow between the same endpoints): different remedies. 02 D-01 (connection floods) against D-02 (accepted-message floods into Pub/Sub): borderline. Both drafts of each pair share one claim identity, so the scorer and the vote ledger cannot tell them apart and no must-find is lost.
reconsider_when: the duplicate grouping key, the critic's duplicate step, or the claim identity rule changes
scope: STRIDE, four Baselines, 13 cases each. The defect exists (2 of 3 rejections) and is rare (3 rejections per 867 kept claims). It costs a remedy in the report, never a must-find. Keeping both drafts would put two kept claims on one identity, which is a claim-identity decision before it is a critic-prompt one.
signature: the critic rejects a draft as a duplicate of a draft in its same_action_as group whose remedy differs

falsifier: no archived draft rests on an open or absent fact that its own source answers
hypothesis: on the archive, some drafts argue against a fact their source states and their model omits, so giving the critic the sources (#1295 finding 2) has a ceiling above zero
intervention: offline read of all 193 STRIDE drafts in Baseline 6bff717, each beside its case source and its unknown-attribute and absent grounds. No draft is defeated by a source sentence the model omits. One borderline: 07 R-02 (manual rebuilds not attributable) beside 'any developer can log in to the build runner'; a login is not attribution, so the draft holds. One harm risk: case 12 quotes a vendor datasheet ('enterprise-grade encryption throughout', 'all access is fully authenticated'), which a critic told that a source fact counts as stated could use to reject I-01, I-03, I-04, S-02 and R-01. The planned 13-call critic replay with sources (about 1.30 USD, approved) was not run, because its precondition was a ceiling above zero.

scope: STRIDE, Baseline 6bff717, 13 cases, analysis mode on blessed models. A blessed model was corrected by a person, so it rarely omits a source fact; an extracted model omits more, and this read says nothing about extraction mode. ADR 0002's prompt-injection argument is a design question no run answers.

intervention: offline read of all 34 STRIDE rejections in the four Baselines, each beside its case source (every source matched the report digest). 6 lane and 3 duplicate rejections turn on no source fact. Of 25 reasoning rejections, 19 turn on none. Strong: 6bff717 07 T-01 (unsigned dependencies planted into releases) was rejected because 'that statement appears only in the flow notes', while the source states 'the runner does not verify signatures on what it downloads'; the corpus marks that claim must-find and its note says the source states the absence outright. Moderate: 6bff717 07 E-01 ('When the image is pushed the runner calls the deploy controller'), d4edd64 01 R-01 ('the order service accepts anything that can reach it'). Weak: 2198870 03 I-07 and d3f1898 03 I-08 ('we have not split member-identifying columns out'), d4edd64 10 S-04 ('an unsecured MySQL connection'). E2 read only the defeat direction and missed this one.

intervention: run.py critic-replay over all 13 cases of Baseline 6bff717, one call each per arm, terra through OpenRouter. Treatment: prompts/critic.md with {input_text} and the step 1 source rule (uncommitted, branch audit/1295-offline-findings). Control: the same tree with prompts/critic.md and prompts/recritic.md at 37f20cdc. Arms agree on 179 of 195 verdicts. 07 T-01: control needs-info, treatment confirmed, so today's prompt without sources already keeps the must-find and E3's loss came from the older critic prompt. Case 12: 16 of 16 agree, no harm. Six drafts needs-info to confirmed under treatment, five resting on facts the source states plainly (02 S-01, 02 T-01, 07 S-01, 07 T-01, 07 T-02). Nine confirmed to needs-info, one rejected to needs-info (01 E-01), one needs-info to rejected (10 T-05); of the changed reasons only 09 I-05 cites the source. Mean cost per call 0.0491 USD treatment, 0.0482 control.
